description: Vertually invincable.  Just look at it.  There is no way for you to beat this deck, seriously.
strategy:
The strategy is your basic hidden base but with power.  Also in the past the only way I have been able to defeat a hidden base deck is by catching the deck off guard with 1 or 2 x-wings at a sight, so I have added Hyper Escape, and It Could be worse to avoid a beatdown.  I can also track the 2 Kessel runs and get a good 10-15 cards back from All Wings Report In.  I can normally cancel 3 force drains a turn and use It Could be Worse to cancle the rest.  The S-Foils give me 6 power for each B-Wing and makes them very powerfull.  This deck is

8-1 in tournament play, and the one loss was by 2 cards and before I added It could be Worse.  Please give me a coment, I would appreciate suggestions.

Thanks,

Joe
